text:
kai: quick FYI — while walking a new teammate through the Node quickstart I hit a telemetry surprise. Info-level logs in staging are leaking user identifiers (email/hash) because the logger snapshot runs before our redaction hook. also seeing repeated X-Req-Id across retries for a short burst.

terry: ugh. which scaffolding version? did we switch logger config in the last PR?

kai: scaffold v1.4.2 from the quickstarts repo. env was REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info (intended), REDWOOD_OTEL=auto. sequence: start app, sign-in, hit /chat fast twice — logs show same reqid `req-1a2b` and both logs contain `user.email` field.

nina: two separate issues but probably related timing: (1) the logging snapshot copies req.body before redaction middleware runs, (2) retry wrapper/OTEL auto-init race produces a shared context that causes duplicated reqid on rapid retries.

ben_p: can you paste the middleware order? also any custom logging hook in the scaffold?

kai: middleware order in quickstart: bodyParser -> otel.autoinit() -> logger.snapshot() -> auth -> redactHook -> retryWrapper -> routes. logger.snapshot() is part of the scaffold utility.

terry: aha. logger.snapshot() should run after redactHook. Also otel.autoinit() being before auth means span attributes capture raw body. We changed scaffold to do OTEL early to let auto-instrumentation pick up headers, but that has privacy implications.

ci-bot: CI lint note — quickstart v1.4.2 passed checks but no telemetry privacy lint exists yet.

nina: quick fixes:
- move logger.snapshot() to after redactHook
- make otel.autoinit() lazy-per-request when REDWOOD_OTEL=auto (or run a sanitizing attribute filter)
- make reqid generation the first middleware (super early)
- add a small in-process guard in reqid middleware: if incoming req matches active context and timestamp delta < 50ms, regenerate a new id

kai: will try moving redact earlier and bumping reqid first.

terry: for longer-term: scaffold templates need parity across Node/Python. Python quickstart already does reqid->redact->logger. Add a telemetry privacy test to the quickstart CI that runs a synthetic request and asserts no email-like strings in logs or span attrs.

ben_p: also add an OTEL attribute processor to strip PII by default unless user opts in. We can keep minimal attributes like path/method/status.

kai: created issue #5012 with repro, logs, and suggested patch. linked PR draft in quickstarts: https://redwood-internal/pulls/quickstart-telemetry-5012 — short-term branch `kai/quickstart-telemetry-fix`.

ci-bot: build queued for branch `kai/quickstart-telemetry-fix` — build 721. staging deploy ETA ~5m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

nina: also note for docs/onboarding: call out that REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info may include request bodies in some quickstart versions and recommend using DEBUG locally only, INFO in staging with redaction enabled.

terry: good catch, kai. this would have been a customer-facing leak in worst-case. thanks for the write-up. :raised_hands:
